prompt: A full-length editorial fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman seated gracefully on a dark walnut wooden staircase inside a quiet, minimalist European-style interior. She sits several steps above the bottom of the staircase, facing directly toward the camera with an elegant, composed expression and relaxed posture. Her hands are gently placed together on her lap, knees positioned naturally beneath the voluminous skirt. She has long, straight-to-softly-wavy jet-black hair, parted slightly to one side, cascading over one shoulder and down the front of her dress. A large oversized black satin bow hair accessory is positioned on the side of her head, creating a striking black-and-white contrast. Her makeup is extremely natural and refined: porcelain-like luminous skin, subtle blush, softly defined dark eyes, naturally shaped brows, and muted rosy lips. Her expression is calm, innocent, delicate, and almost doll-like without looking exaggerated. She is wearing an ethereal ivory-white formal ballgown made from lightweight, slightly textured fabric. The dress has a fitted bodice with a defined waist, a simple elegant rounded square neckline, and dramatic short puff sleeves with substantial gathered volume around the shoulders and upper arms. The waist is cleanly cinched, transitioning into an enormous, sculptural full skirt. The skirt is the focal point of the outfit: extremely voluminous, layered, asymmetrical and high-low in construction, with soft cascading folds and overlapping layers of ivory fabric. The front of the skirt rises enough to reveal her lower legs and shoes while the sides and back extend dramatically outward and downward across the staircase. The fabric pools naturally over several wooden steps, creating an elegant flowing silhouette. The skirt should feel luxurious but not overly ornate, with no embroidery, no sequins, no lace, no visible patterns, relying entirely on shape, volume, texture, and draping. Beneath the raised front of the skirt, she wears black pointed-toe pumps with delicate black bow embellishments. The shoes are partially concealed by the dress but clearly visible between the folds. The staircase is made from rich dark brown polished walnut wood, featuring broad wooden steps, traditional turned wooden balusters, a substantial handrail, and a large decorative newel post in the foreground. The staircase rises behind her and creates strong architectural symmetry. The surrounding walls are warm off-white/cream, completely minimal and undecorated, with a pale natural wooden floor visible at the bottom. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with the woman occupying the visual center while the staircase creates strong leading lines around her. The camera is positioned at approximately eye level to slightly below eye level, capturing her entire body and the dramatic spread of the gown.
